resources.string: Masks the LINE promotional banner and every bottom tab except Chats; masks Contacts, Discover and Me in WeChat. If WeChat hides its accessibility content, captures its window and recognizes only the bottom strip on-device. No images or chat content are saved or sent.

LINE: hides the promotional banner and every bottom tab except Chats.

WeChat: hides Contacts, Discover and Me, leaving Chats visible.

Covers are visual only: touches still pass through.
Works only while LINE or WeChat is on screen. WeChat may use on-device image recognition of the bottom navigation. No images or chat content are saved or sent. No network access.
LINE is not installed or cannot be opened.
WeChat is not installed or cannot be opened.
